description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeQualificationsController class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base controller to manage employee qualification data, specifically preparing data for views related to employee language fluencies and competencies, and setting appropriate permissions based on employee data.

classes.name: EmployeeQualificationsController
classes.description: Controller for handling employee qualification views and permissions within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and configures the employee qualifications component with language fluencies and competencies, based on the employee's ID from the request, or handles a bad request if no employee number is provided.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns a list of qualification-related permission identifiers for capability validation.
